versions.assignment_rule: Baseline actors remain on 43304bf. Each regression call is assigned the latest deployment receipt at or before call.at; an earlier call remains baseline. Later deployment receipts never relabel earlier replies.
versions.cross_revision_sessions: A regression test_id stays stable within its profile across deployments. source_commits and per-turn source_commit show revision boundaries inside the same conversation.

scope.quality_review: Manual findings are supplied separately. No answer quality pass rate is inferred from HTTP, session or result statuses.
scope.counting: Messages count call records with message input. Approval requests include their repeated submissions; approval_replays are a subset, detected by the same session and decision key. Session creation and citation checks are not conversational messages. Source-specific session counts overlap when one conversation crosses deployments.
scope.usage: Actual model tokens sum accounting.daily_model_token_delta once per call. charged_upper is summed independently and includes conservative allowances. run_usage_snapshot is the returned per-run snapshot, may repeat on approvals or replays, and is never summed as new model usage.
scope.missing: Missing observations remain null/missing. known_sum is partial when missing_call_records is nonzero; no missing evidence is treated as a pass.
scope.privacy: Only synthetic inputs, edited business arguments, replies and allowlisted metadata are exported. Runtime/account identifiers, request/decision keys, credentials, raw responses, traces and local paths are excluded or redacted.
